tonight.headline: Up 0.4. Monday night decides it: Barkley against their Eagles D/ST
body: You lead 93.8 to 93.4, but ESPN makes you a 45% underdog. Your last player is Barkley (17.4 projected) on Monday night. JuiceJam still have the rest of Dak Prescott's game in Rio, Tyler Loop, and the Eagles D/ST in that same Monday game.

There's nothing to change: Barkley is your only unlocked starter and he stays in. Their D/ST faces Case Keenum, Chicago's third-string quarterback, in his first start since 2023. That's the matchup that beats you.

case.label: Their D/ST
case.body: Jay Glazer reported this morning that Keenum starts over Tyson Bagent, who cleared the concussion protocol but missed two practices (FOX). Caleb Williams is out (hamstring). A 38-year-old backup gives a defence sacks and turnovers.

case.label: Your back
case.body: Barkley was a full practice participant with the stinger and is off the report. Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley are available too (Eagles.com final report). Week 2's 4 carries came from the stinger, not a demotion.

case.label: Their hole
case.body: Nico Collins was ruled out and stayed in JuiceJam's WR slot: a zero they chose to keep.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley re-aggravating the neck early on Monday, or Dak's late game swinging the gap before then.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: WHEN THE WEEK ROLLS · Downs is on waivers until Wed 01:00 Mexico City. Add him only after that, as a free agent, and only if Lloyd's clause trips
doFirst.title: If Lloyd's clause trips: drop him, add Josh Downs once he clears
doFirst.subtitle: Not armed. Downs's case got stronger today. The only open question is Lloyd's archive line. Never spend priority on this.

case.label: The add got stronger
case.body: Downs led the Colts with 11 targets and caught 5 for 77 in a 19-17 win over Houston (NBC). His falsifier was under five targets with Pierce and Dulin out, and it didn't come close to firing. Pierce is on IR (heel) for at least four weeks.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Lloyd was the RB3 on Thursday: 15 snaps to Brooks's 26 and Kaleb Johnson's 22. Acme Packing Co. call him 'officially the RB3'. His clause needs a second straight week of being out-touched, and the Week 3 archive (out Tuesday) settles it. He's 67.9% owned, and I'm disagreeing with the market because the snap order, not a box score, says he's third.

case.label: The price
case.body: Downs moved to WAIVERS when his game kicked off. Claims clear at 07:00 UTC Wednesday (01:00 Mexico City). If nobody claims him, he's a free agent Wednesday morning and costs nothing. Don't claim him before then: IPADE priority never resets, and a WR4 isn't a starter-level need.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The archive shows Lloyd leading Green Bay's backs in Thursday touches, or Jacobs is reinstated. Either one keeps him. For Downs: Pierce returning within four weeks. If executed and Lloyd outscores Downs in two of the next three weeks, it closes WRONG.

case.body: The card above. The seat opens once the archive confirms a second week, and Downs is the named replacement.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The archive showing Lloyd with the most touches on Thursday despite the snap order.

trades.theirGainLine: Their gain is +1.7 a week: Tuten (11.0) replaces Rachaad White (9.3) in their second RB slot, and Lamar scores them nothing behind Josh Allen.

case.label: Their surplus
case.body: Re-checked on the 21:52 snapshot: Lamar is at slot 20 behind Josh Allen at slot 0, White is at slot 2, and Blake Corum (9.0) is on their bench. Baltimore played Dallas in Rio today. Nothing I found puts Lamar on a report.

case.label: Your gain
case.body: Lamar 20.1 against Lawrence's 16.4 on this week's projections: +3.7. Season projections: Lamar 297.3, Tuten 166.9.

case.label: Honest risk
case.body: On raw season totals it looks lopsided in your favour, which is why it's a longshot. Their weekly gain is real but small. Tuten had a good day (17.0), which helps you sell him and doesn't change what he's worth to them.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Team 13 start a second real back over White, drop or trade a quarterback, or Lamar lands on a Baltimore report. Don't re-send it. Respond only if they open the conversation.

trades.copyText: Hi, would you do Lamar for Bhayshul Tuten? Lamar can't start for you behind Allen, and Tuten (11.0 projected, 17 today) would start over White for you. Your weekly gain is real.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Eight risers and one faller from two weeks of data, which is thin. Only one riser has a role reason that holds: Downs, whose conditional card got stronger today with 11 targets. The rest are handcuffs, fill-ins for injured starters, or timeshares. Gadsden is falling but locked into the seat until 30 Sep.
